display_title: The End of Spite Is Pure Love
description:
Seo Yu-ju, the owner of Cafe Sallang, is kind to everyone except for the Taoists.
Do Kang-hyun is a fourth-generation chaebol with a foul mouth but a good heart.

Kang-hyun, who went to retrieve a painting by an unknown artist at his grandfather's request, meets Yu-ju, who is determined not to let her grandmother's painting be taken away.

"Why do you dislike me?"

Yu-ju's coldness causes Kang-hyun to change his plan to just buy the painting and return, and he seizes the opportunity to even move into her house.

"Hey, Do Kang-hyun. It's just a hand touch..."
"A hand touch? You kneaded someone's body like dough, and you say it was just a hand touch?"
"When did I ever knead dough—"
"You did! Seo Yu-ju, have your fill with your own hands!"

Life under the same roof is anything but peaceful. It is a story about how a dog-cat relationship turns into a mutual one and only existence. Malice turns into interest, and ultimately, it leads to pure love.
